rule: Only one feature may be in_progress at a time. 'passing' requires verification evidence produced on the current host.

features.title: Windows portability of e2e/dev process spawns
features.user_visible_behavior: `npm run e2e` and `npm run dev` run on Windows/PowerShell without spawn ENOENT/EINVAL.
verification: run twice to confirm port 7331 frees between runs
features.evidence: 2026-07-18 this host (node 24.14.0): npm run e2e -> 17/17 PASS, 'E2E + GATE GREEN', exit 0 on two consecutive runs. Fix: e2e.mjs relay via `process.execPath --import tsx`; dev.mjs shell:true + taskkill /T tree-kill.
features.notes: Root cause: spawn('npx'|'npm') without shell -> ENOENT; .cmd form -> EINVAL on modern Node (CVE-2024-27980).

features.title: D1-D3 backbone: MCP round-trip relay <-> app over ws
features.user_visible_behavior: An MCP client sees the app's tools via tools/list and a tools/call executes a real action in the app; two concurrent sessions coexist.
verification: expect PASS: tools/list ok, add_task write lands in board, list_tasks read, two concurrent MCP sessions coexist, internal primer hidden
features.evidence: 2026-07-18: e2e PASS on tools/list, add_task->board, list_tasks, 2 concurrent sessions, __gmc_ready hidden.
features.notes: Per-session McpServer regresses the LM Studio 'Already connected' crash.

features.title: D4-D5 policy gate: pause/approve/deny + fidelity + audit
features.user_visible_behavior: Destructive tool call pauses at the gate; approve runs it, deny returns isError with no mutation; hidden unicode in args is flagged and canonical bytes execute; every call is audited.
verification: expect PASS: destructive paused (pending), approved runs + board cleared, denied isError + board unchanged, tampered args flagged, canonical strips hidden unicode, audit records pending/allow/deny
features.evidence: 2026-07-18: e2e PASS on all gate assertions incl. canonical strips hidden unicode ({id:'t1'}) and audit intent/allow/deny.
features.notes: Risk authoritative in embinder.policy.json; destructiveHint is only an app-side default.

features.title: D6 hardening: token/origin bind + anti self-approve
features.user_visible_behavior: The ws /app is token-gated; a decide call with the wrong approver token is rejected (403); relay binds loopback with Host/Origin allowlist.
features.evidence: 2026-07-18: e2e PASS on wrong-token 403 and token-authenticated ws /app open.
features.notes: AC-7 rate limit (per-tool/60s) is NOT exercised by e2e on this host - manual only; tracked under F-D8.

features.title: In-app chat bubble driven through the relay /chat gate (T-CB)
features.user_visible_behavior: An in-app <ChatBubble> talks to an LLM via relay POST /chat; tool calls run through the same policy gate; destructive calls pause for approval; off-allowlist LLM baseURL is rejected and CORS preflight is honored.
verification: expect PASS: /chat streamed ok (200), chat tool call landed via the gate, chat destructive paused + ran after approval, off-allowlist baseURL -> 400, /approver-token disabled by default -> 403, CORS preflight -> 204 + echoes app origin
features.evidence: 2026-07-18: e2e (post-Embinder-sync) PASS on all chat-bubble assertions via a deterministic stub LLM.
features.notes: Feature-flagged. Headless only (stub LLM) - real-browser bubble click-through is unverified (see F-D8).

features.title: PocketBase Admin UI resident agent integration
features.user_visible_behavior: The PocketBase Admin UI connects to the Embinder relay, exposes render-scoped navigation and active-collection record tools, provides live screen context, and includes the resident agent chat bubble with destructive record deletion gated out-of-tab.
features.evidence: 2026-07-18 this host: npm run typecheck -> exit 0; npm run e2e -> all assertions PASS and 'E2E + GATE GREEN'; npm run test --prefix apps/pocketbase/ui -> 3/3 PASS, including relay call execution regression coverage; npm run build --prefix apps/pocketbase/ui -> Vite production build exit 0 (204 modules transformed); live browser verification against :8090 -> status Ready, enabled chat input, shared ghost cursor mounted, and no console errors.
features.notes: User-directed feature. PocketBase is a vanilla JS + Shablon + Vite SPA, so it uses the framework-neutral JSON-over-WebSocket bridge while reusing the shared agent cursor visualization from @embinder/react.

features.title: Live-browser + spotlight + rate-limit behavioral proof
features.user_visible_behavior: The same round-trip works through the real @embinder/react provider + DOM at :5173, the driver.js spotlight locks the destructive element, and AC-7 rate limit denies over-limit calls.
verification: call delete_all_tasks -> confirm spotlight locks the element + gate pending, approve at /approve
features.notes: Code for provider/spotlight/rate-limit exists (BUILD_STATUS D1-D7) but is NOT behaviorally verified on this host. Spotlight is enabled via the `viz` prop on <EmbinderProvider> and code-split.
